04 — The process

From idea
to identity.

A clear, collaborative path designed to make the creative process feel exciting — never overwhelming.

01

Discover

Understand the business, audience, goals, personality, and vision. We uncover what makes the brand worth remembering.

02

Define

Establish the creative direction and brand foundation — the visual language that everything else will follow.

03

Design

Develop the logo, visuals, promotional materials, and brand assets with thoughtful iterations and detail.

04

Build

Create a cohesive brand experience across physical and digital touchpoints so every interaction feels connected.

05

Launch

Deliver the final brand assets and guidance needed to confidently put your new identity into the world.

08 — Questions

Let’s clear
things up.

What does a branding project include?−

It can include strategy guidance, logo creation, visual direction, business cards, promotional materials, merchandise design and practical brand guidance, depending on your project.

How does the logo design process work?+

We start with discovery and direction, then move into concepts, refinement and final delivery so the finished mark feels purposeful and usable.

Do you design business cards and promotional materials?+

Yes. These are part of the service offering and can be designed as a coordinated extension of your brand identity.

Do you create custom merchandise designs?+

Yes. Merchandise can be developed to carry the same visual language into physical products and branded experiences.

Do you work with startups?+

Absolutely. Startup consultations are designed to help new businesses establish a professional visual foundation from the beginning.

How do I get started?+

Send a project inquiry below with your business details, service needs and project goals. Her Designs can then guide the next step.
